The Atlas Archaeon harvester matches only archaeon/campaignN/, so archaeon/envgate, archaeon/envgate2 and archaeon/z80atlas are not harvested
No other Atlas harvester or registry root indexes envgate, envgate2 or z80atlas (including Nestor's roles/Nestor/campaigns/z80atlas-*)

atlas/harvest/npe.py:28-31 (Nestor harvester is scoped to graphworld and cw01-2026-09-17 only)
atlas/harvest/commits.py:37 (only counts paths per commit, does not map them to experiments)
